## Project data

### Project 1: Influenza notifications

**Source:** Australian National Notifiable Disease Surveillance System (NNDSS).

The analysis uses weekly laboratory-confirmed influenza notifications aggregated to monthly national totals for 2008–2019. Data preparation and aggregation are documented in the analysis.

- [Influenza dataset — Excel](../projects/project-01/nndss-public-dataset-influenza-laboratory-confirmed.xlsx)
- [Source data caveats — PDF](../projects/project-01/influenza_laboratory_confirmed_public_dataset_2008_to_2024_data_caveats_0.pdf)
- [Data preparation and analysis](../projects/project-01/code.qmd)

### Project 2: Financial index returns

**Source:** Yahoo Finance, using the FTSE/JSE Top 40 Index ticker `^J200.JO`.

The analysis requests daily prices from 2 January 2017 to 12 October 2026 and converts adjusted closing prices to log returns. Missing prices are supplemented using the local `SA40.csv` file. The download and preparation steps are included in the analysis.

The parameter-recovery study uses simulated GARCH data generated by the submitted code.

- [Supplementary price dataset — CSV](../projects/project-02/SA40.csv)
- [Data access, preparation and simulation code](../projects/project-02/Project%202.qmd)

### Project 3: Crime and economic indicators

**Sources:** SAPS Annual Crime Records and Statistics South Africa CPI data accessed through DataFirst; GDP and unemployment series accessed through FRED.

The analysis combines annual crime and economic indicators for 2005–2025. The code documents variable selection, CPI preparation, aggregation and matching by year.

- [Crime dataset — CSV](../projects/project-03/sapacr-2005-2026-v1.5.csv)
- [GDP dataset — CSV](../projects/project-03/real%20gdp.csv)
- [Unemployment dataset — CSV](../projects/project-03/unemployment%20rate.csv)
- [CPI dataset, 2000–2008 — Excel](../projects/project-03/cpi-2000-2008-v1.xlsx)
- [CPI dataset, 2008–2026 — Excel](../projects/project-03/cpi-2008-2026-v1.1.xlsx)
- [Data preparation and analysis](../projects/project-03/Project%203.qmd)

### Project 4: Simulated state space data

This project uses simulated data rather than an external dataset. The analysis contains the data-generating equations, parameter settings, random-seed settings and code for the simulation experiments.

- [Simulation and Kalman filter code](../projects/project-04/Project%204.qmd)

## Reproducing the work

The source portfolio contains the Quarto `.qmd` files and supporting materials.

To reproduce an analysis:

1.  Open the portfolio as a Quarto project.
2.  Install the R packages listed or loaded in the relevant analysis.
3.  Keep the supplied data files in their existing project folders.
4.  Run the analysis from the beginning so that data preparation and model objects are created in order.
5.  Render the analysis or the complete website.

Some analyses download data and therefore require an internet connection. External data may change after the original analysis. Simulation results depend on the random seeds and settings specified in the code.

The rendered website provides the results for reading, while the source files provide the code needed to reproduce them.
